apps.name: INFORMANT
apps.description:
Local workspace for researching YouTube videos, articles, and Reddit posts. Organize work into projects, keep notes and bookmarks on each item, and run chat or analysis against the material you collected. No YouTube account login — API keys go in Settings.

## Features
- Project-based workspace: create, search, sort, rename, export, and delete projects
- Import YouTube, article, and Reddit URLs (single links or mixed batches)
- Android share-target: share a link into INFORMANT to start or fill a project
- Per-item tabs for notes, bookmarks, transcripts, comments, chat, and custom AI actions
- Quote bookmarks in articles/Reddit; timestamp bookmarks on videos with jump-to
- Fetch and search YouTube captions; click a line to seek the player
- Pull YouTube or Reddit comment threads, search/filter, and favorite comments
- Project-wide chat and AI actions across selected items, with a Texts tab for context
- One floating YouTube player (inline, expanded, or PiP) with saved playback position
- Export/import project JSON with selectable artifacts
- External search from highlighted text (Perplexity, Google, ChatGPT, and more)

## Content & tools
Open a card for tabs that match the content type:
- **YouTube** — Info, Comments, Transcript, Notes, Bookmarks, Chat / AI actions
- **Articles** — Reader, Notes, Bookmarks, Chat / AI actions
- **Reddit** — Post reader, Comments, Notes, Bookmarks, Chat / AI actions

Built-in AI actions include summary, analysis, key takeaways, and lists. You can add your own. Outputs can include mind maps when relevant.

## Platforms
- **Android** — Capacitor build; IndexedDB on device; native share import
- **Desktop** — Windows portable / local server; projects as JSON; artifacts in SQLite (`informant.db`)

## Requirements
Optional keys in Settings (or `.env` on desktop): Gemini, YouTube Data API, YouTube Transcript API, Webshare for scraping/transcripts.

apps.name: Rush
apps.description:
Unofficial Rush companion for Android — browse the discography, read lyrics and album notes, explore the band, and build a personal collection of pins, ratings, lyric quotes, and YouTube links.

## Features
- Home with explore shortcuts, featured content, and spotlight into the catalog
- Discography with artwork, decade grouping, and studio / live / solo filters
- Album pages with About, Tracks, Videos, Credits, Liner Notes, and Awards
- Track list shows per-track YouTube video counts when videos are present
- Album Videos tab aggregates official and user-added YouTube links by track
- Song pages with Lyrics, Appears On, and Videos tabs
- My Collection for pins, ratings, lyric quotes, notes, and custom YouTube links
- The Band history and member pages, studio Timeline, search, random song/video
- Offline bundled catalog; collection data stored on device

## Platforms
- Android (Jetpack Compose), minSdk 26
- Package ID: com.rykersoft.rush

## Requirements
- Android 8.0+
- Internet for YouTube links and external search

apps.name: Synthing
apps.description:
Android music sketchpad with continuous infinite arrangement, 100% bird's eye overhead timeline views, scale-aware melody keyboard, chord grid, and dual synth voices with a native low-latency Oboe engine.

## Features
- **Continuous Infinite Arrangement**: Single continuous arrangement timeline with auto-expanding bounds and arrangement-wide loop IN/OUT markers.
- **Piano Roll 100% Bird's Eye View**: Overhead bird's eye view of the entire arrangement for 1:1 timeline scrolling and navigation while preserving zoom.
- **Play Header Mini-Map**: Compact bird's eye mini-map on the Play tab top navigation bar for instant playhead scrubbing and punch-in recording.
- **Simplified Project Manager**: Visual project cards featuring live arrangement preview canvases for every saved project.
- **Dual Synth Voices**: Independent Synth A and Synth B subtractive synth engines with per-preset automations, filter envelopes, and FX.
- **Chord Grid & Performance Toggles**: Isomorphic and standard pad layouts with Glide, Slide, Latch, Tog, and step-sequenced arpeggiators.
- **Melody Keyboard & Touch Modulators**: Scale-aware keyboard with pitch-class color highlighting and multi-touch expression modulators.
- **Piano Roll Editor**: Touchpad-controlled note editing, step-quantize snapping, and multi-lane parameter automation.

## Platforms
- **Android**: API 24+ (arm64-v8a / armeabi-v7a / x86 / x86_64) native Oboe C++ engine.
apps.changelog:
- Fixed arrangement note playback when tapping Play
- Preserves notes across full continuous timeline without 4-bar truncation
- Auto-resets playhead to IN point if parked past end of song
- Official RykerSoft Application Package ID (com.rykersoft.synthing)

apps.name: SuperThink.ing
apps.description:
SuperThink.ing is a multimodal knowledge workspace built around cards and tabs for text, chat, image, audio, and video. Transform content with reusable AI actions, write song sheets and mind maps, link audio into notes or lyrics, transcribe speech, and work locally as a guest or sync with Firebase when signed in.

## Features
- Multimodal cards with text, chat, image, audio, and video tabs
- Reusable AI action system for transform, generate, OCR, TTS, video, web research, and custom JS utilities
- Markdown editor and rich preview with song sheets, Markmap, Mermaid, and GFM
- Linked audio clips in text/song content with queue, repeat, shuffle, and auto-scroll
- Chat tabs with tab context, media attachments, applyable tab edits, and TTS
- Transcription via Groq Whisper (default), OpenAI Whisper fallback, or Gemini — including local video and YouTube
- Vault organization with categories, tags, list/grid/kanban, floating windows, and batch ZIP
- Templates, ZIP import/export, and Android share-intent import
- Guest local storage or Firebase Auth/Firestore/Storage sync
- Web, Android, and Electron from one codebase

## Workspace & organization
- Vault sidebar with search, category grouping, sort cycling, and compact/expanded density
- Category overview with card counts, tab-type indicators, and relative edit times
- List, grid, and kanban views
- Sort by alphabetical, newly added, last viewed, last edited, last used, or manual order
- Kanban category columns with drag-and-drop, collapse, density, and column sort modes
- Pinning; card states: collapsed, expanded, maximized
- Category colors and optional per-card color
- Tags and metadata editing (single-card and batch)
- Quick selector overlay for fast card switching
- Floating cards: pop-out, drag/resize, minimize tray, tile/close all
- Dual-pane layout inside a card (side-by-side or stacked)
- Batch duplicate, delete, metadata edit, and ZIP download
- Card Chat Editor for plain-language batch edits across selected cards

## Cards & tabs
- Tab types: TEXT, CHAT, IMAGE, AUDIO, VIDEO
- Create, rename, hide, duplicate, delete, reorder, and color tabs
- Tab Manager modal with drag reorder
- Natural-language Tab Manager AI (Gemini) for tab operations
- Per-tab preview vs edit for text; per-tab audio recording preference overrides
- Context menus on cards, tab bars, text tabs, and media tabs

## Text editing & markdown
- Markdown editor with formatting toolbar, undo/redo, and find/replace
- Preview with GFM; editor/preview font and size controls
- Dictation into text; read aloud for selection or full content
- Word Lab (Datamuse): rhymes, near rhymes, similar/related words, sounds-like, adjectives-for, followers
- Selection search to AI, web, social, or custom destinations
- Insert Song, Mind Map, Full Tab Map, Mermaid, tab links, text, or code fences
- Cross-card wiki links `[[Exact Card Title]]` as AI context sources
- Send text or selection to another tab; share text
- Print / save as PDF from preview
- Export standalone HTML (or ZIP with linked audio) with song and playback controls

## Song & music tools
- Fenced song blocks with chord tokens, section headers, and stage directions
- Chord show/hide; hide section headers, stage directions, or audio links
- Transpose by semitone; variation syntax `{opt1|opt2}` with configurable colors
- Configurable major/minor chord colors
- Song section jumper dock (previous/next/jump)
- Preview auto-scroll (teleprompter-style) with speed control
- HTML export extras: section navigation, metronome, loop section, transpose, play-all, audio scroll

## Diagrams & mind maps
- Markmap blocks and Full Tab Map with pan/zoom/fit and expand/collapse
- Mermaid diagrams (including mermaid mindmaps)
- Export diagrams as SVG or PNG
- Built-in Mind Map action and editor snippets

## Chat & AI conversation
- Dedicated chat tabs with per-tab model, temperature, system prompt, and history limits
- Draft messages and attachments persist across tab switches
- Context references to other tabs; media attachments on messages
- Regenerate responses; token and storage estimates
- Tab-edit proposals from the assistant (Apply / Undo)
- Chat message text-to-speech into an audio tab
- Send chat content to another tab

## AI actions
- Action types: text-to-text, text-to-image, image-to-text, text-to-audio, audio-to-text, text-to-video, image-to-video, web-search, utility
- Built-in library including summarize, mind map, grammar, web research, visualize, video generation, OCR, image describe/animate, speech summarize, code refactor, and multiple TTS presets
- Custom Action Builder (one-off) and Action Editor (save reusable actions)
- Action Manager with favorites, categories, and tags
- AI-assisted action metadata generation and prompt optimization
- Utility actions including custom JavaScript transforms
- Destination: new tab or existing tab; insert modes REPLACE, APPEND, PREPEND
- Extra context sources from cards/tabs; selection-aware execution
- External execute via Perplexity, Gemini, ChatGPT, or Claude
- Optional cloud action catalog for signed-in users

## Media
- Images: upload, camera capture, crop, OCR, send to tab, download/share, multi-select bulk operations
- Audio: upload, record with sample rate/bitrate/channels/Opus/AGC/echo/noise/device options, waveform trim and removal regions, export MP3/WAV via FFmpeg, global audio player
- Video: file upload, YouTube/URL entries, external playback, transcription
- Rename media, send across cards/tabs, share, remove from tab, or delete file

## Linked audio & transcription
- Link audio clips into text or song content with start/end regions
- Inline controls and preview transport: play queue, repeat, shuffle, autoplay, auto-scroll
- Transcription via Groq Whisper (default), optional OpenAI Whisper fallback, or Gemini
- Local video to audio extract (FFmpeg WASM) then the same speech-to-text stack
- YouTube captions via TubeText with Gemini multimodal fallback
- Failed-transcription recovery that keeps audio for retry

## Import, export & share
- Single-card and batch ZIP export; ZIP import restoring content and media
- Template ZIP export from Settings
- Text HTML export; audio MP3/WAV; diagram SVG/PNG
- Android share-intent import for text, image, video, audio, and files into a chosen card or tab
- Native DownloadSaver plugin writes files to the public Downloads folder

## Mobile & Android
- Capacitor Android app with package ID `com.rykersoft.superthinking`
- Long-press context menus with configurable duration; tab swipe preference
- Mobile FAB and action sheet for common workspace actions
- MicrophoneRouting plugin for preferred mic / Bluetooth routing and level monitoring
- Share-target import and Downloads saver

## Desktop (Electron)
- Capacitor Community Electron wrapper with portable packaging
- Floating windows and dual-pane layouts especially useful on desktop

## Settings & providers
- API keys: Gemini, Groq (default STT), OpenAI (STT fallback), ElevenLabs
- Gemini model catalog and custom model IDs; default text and Tab Manager models
- Dictation model choice (Groq Whisper vs Gemini) and recording defaults
- Personas/boilerplates for text, mindmap, image, video, audio, utility, and chat
- UI preferences: fonts, long-press, tab swipe, maximize behavior, category colors, selection-search targets
- Storage analysis; Firebase Storage toggle; template management
- Providers in use: Gemini, Groq Whisper, OpenAI Whisper, ElevenLabs, Datamuse, TubeText, Firebase Auth/Firestore/Storage

## Storage & sync
- Guest mode: cards/templates/preferences in local storage; media in IndexedDB; no cloud sync
- Signed-in mode: Firestore realtime sync for cards/actions/templates/preferences; Firebase Storage for media with offline caching
- Device-local UI layout preferences (list/kanban, column sorts) are not fully cross-device synced
- Empty cloud vaults can migrate existing guest cards on sign-in

## Platforms
- Android (Capacitor) — primary hub distribution as a signed APK
- Web (Vite + React)
- Desktop (Electron portable builds)

## Requirements
- User-supplied API keys for the AI, speech-to-text, and TTS providers you use
- Network access for cloud AI providers and optional Firebase sync
- Android 7+ recommended for the APK build

apps.name: bettertracking
apps.description:
Track food, supplements, exercise, measurements, lifestyle, and notes in one journal — with an adaptive calorie engine, AI logging and coaching, reminders, and cloud sync that works offline.

## Features
- Six-domain journal: Food, Supplement, Exercise, Measurement, Lifestyle, and Note
- Day, week, and month views with filters, sort, search, grouping, and trend charts
- Personal library of ingredients and combos (macros/micros, units, tags, custom fields, routines)
- Staging tray to batch-log items with quantities and day-target awareness
- Quick Log from text and/or photo with AI nutrition estimates
- Adaptive calorie/macro targets (Mifflin–St Jeor + weight trend; optional Energy Bank carryover)
- AI chat assistant with tools (navigate, library/logs, create/update items, profile, reminders, log edits)
- Health Coach Analysis for day/week/month; background monthly reports
- Speech-to-text (Groq/OpenAI Whisper) for tray, chat, and quick-add
- Scheduled reminders and local notifications (item schedules, wake/sleep, per-domain toggles)
- Firebase Auth + Firestore sync with IndexedDB offline; export logs and library JSON

## Platforms
- **Android** — Capacitor release APK for the RykerSoft hub (`com.rykersoft.bettertracking`)
- **Web** — Vite app with PWA support on HTTPS/localhost
- **Windows** — Electron portable build from the same codebase

## Requirements
- Gemini API key for AI features (Profile or build env)
- Groq and/or OpenAI API key recommended for cloud speech-to-text
- Firebase (bundled project config, or your own `VITE_FIREBASE_*` values)
apps.changelog:
- Display name standardized to bettertracking across Android, Electron, PWA, and docs
- Hub screenshots added for the RykerSoft listing
- Package ID remains com.rykersoft.bettertracking
